scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @codeshield-ai/shared && npm run build --workspace @codeshield-ai/cli && npm run build --workspace @codeshield-ai/sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @codeshield-ai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @codeshield-ai/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @codeshield-ai/sdk
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @codeshield-ai/cli && npm run test --workspace @codeshield-ai/sdk
scripts.check:contracts: npm run generate:contracts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/shared/openapi.json packages/shared/src/generated.ts
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache --workspace @codeshield-ai/cli && npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache --workspace @codeshield-ai/sdk && npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache --workspace @codeshield-ai/shared
